Dear Mr Halstead,

I am writing you about the heating in the flat, because it is not working since four day and the weather outside is very cold now.

Firstly, the problem is start on Saturday morning. The boiler in the kitchen make a strange noise for two minutes and after that it stop alone. Now all the radiator in the flat are cold, only the small one in the bathroom is a little warm. I press the reset button many times and I look also the pressure like you tell me in the winter, but nothing is change.

Secondly, it is really horrible in here. In the night I sleep with two blanket and I still feel the cold, and my little daughter is sick from three days, she cough all the time. I work in the home in the morning but I can not stay in the living room more than one hour because my hands are frozen. Also the water is not hot enough for a shower.

Thirdly, please send a technician for repair the boiler. If nothing happen I will not pay the rent of this month.

Best regards,

Ayse Demir

why_this_band.task_response: The fault and its effect are described in detail, but half of the third point is missing: what needs to be done is stated, but when it should be done is completely absent, and no suitable day is suggested for access. The rent threat in the closing breaks the semi-formal register expected with a landlord.
why_this_band.coherence_cohesion: Firstly / Secondly / Thirdly are mechanically laid over the points, and the third paragraph finishes in two sentences. The fault–effect–request order is still logical, though, and the reader can follow what happened.
why_this_band.lexical_resource: Word choice is everyday and repetitive: cold appears three times, really horrible is a pattern that gives no measure, and there is no field-specific vocabulary beyond boiler and radiator. Forms such as sick from three days and nothing is change stop the reader for a moment.
why_this_band.grammatical_range_accuracy: Almost every sentence has an error: is not working since four day, the problem is start, the boiler in the kitchen make, all the radiator in the flat are, nothing is change, for repair, if nothing happen. Structures are simple sentences and sequences added with and/but.

answers.what_would_lift_it: Complete the third point: state by when the repair is expected and suggest a day and time that suit access for the technician. Removing the rent threat and using a polite but firm closing would also settle the register.

answers.text:
Dear Mr Halstead,

I am writing to inform you that the heating in the flat at 3B Wexford Court has not worked since Saturday morning, and the temperature outside has dropped a lot in the last days.

On Saturday the boiler in the kitchen made a loud noise and then it switched off by itself. Since that moment all the radiators are cold, except the small one in the bathroom which is slightly warm. I have pressed the reset button several times and I checked the pressure as you showed me last winter, but the display still shows the same error code, F28. The hot water is also affected, so we can only have a very short shower in the morning.

The situation is becoming difficult for us. My daughter is six years old and she has had a cough since three days, and at night we sleep under two blankets and still feel cold. I work from home in the mornings, but I can not stay in the living room for a long time because the room is now about 14 degrees.

I would be grateful if you could arrange for a heating engineer to visit before the weekend, because the forecast says the temperature will fall again on Friday night. I am at home every day after four o'clock and all day on Wednesday, so it is easy for me to give the access.

Kind regards,

Ayse Demir

why_this_band.task_response: All three points are addressed and the third is complete: it has the repair request, a date, and suitable times for access, and the register is polite but firm. The description of the fault stays a somewhat sequential list; which attempt led to which result is not spelled out one by one, just counted.
why_this_band.coherence_cohesion: The paragraphing maps onto the points, and openings such as The situation is becoming difficult guide the reader. Transitions are mostly built through time expressions, with limited variety of linking words.
why_this_band.lexical_resource: Field words such as reset button, error code, heating engineer, forecast, give the access are used and the semi-formal register is maintained. In places such as dropped a lot and give the access, the choice and article do not quite settle.
why_this_band.grammatical_range_accuracy: The present perfect, a relative clause and reason clauses are controlled, and most sentences are error-free. The remaining errors (since three days, have been needed instead of all the radiators are cold, in the last days, I can not) do not block meaning.

answers.what_would_lift_it: Write the attempts together with their results (what happened after the reset, whether the pressure dropped), and correct the time expressions; this would pull up both the description of the fault and the grammar at the same time.

answers.text:
Dear Mr Halstead,

I am sorry to trouble you again so soon, but the heating at 3B Wexford Court has been out of action since Saturday morning and the weather has turned much colder this week.

The boiler in the kitchen made a loud knocking sound for a minute or two on Saturday and then shut itself down. Every radiator in the flat has been cold since then, apart from the towel rail in the bathroom, which is faintly warm. I have reset the unit three times and checked the pressure gauge as you showed me last winter; it sits within the normal range, but the display returns to the same fault code, F28, within a few minutes. The hot water comes through only lukewarm, which suggests the problem is with the boiler itself rather than with the radiators.

Four days of this are beginning to tell. The living room was at 14 degrees when I measured it yesterday morning, which makes it hard to work at my desk, and my six-year-old daughter has picked up a cough that she cannot seem to shake off. We are sleeping under two blankets and using a small fan heater in one room, though I am reluctant to leave it running.

Could you arrange for a heating engineer to come before Friday, when the forecast says the temperature will drop again? I am at home after four o'clock on any weekday and all day on Wednesday, so access will not be a problem. If it is easier, I am happy to call an engineer myself and forward the invoice to you.

Kind regards,

Ayse Demir

why_this_band.task_response: All three points are developed: the fault is given with its symptoms and the results of what was tried, the effect with measurable detail (14 degrees, four days), and the request with a date and access times. A warm but firm register suited to the relationship with the landlord is maintained throughout, and the offer of an alternative in the final sentence makes the letter cooperative.
why_this_band.coherence_cohesion: The letter follows the order fault, evidence, effect, request, and the paragraph Four days of this are beginning to tell opens on its own. Links built with which suggests and though carry the relationship within the structure itself.
why_this_band.lexical_resource: Items such as out of action, pressure gauge, fault code, lukewarm, shake off are used with the right collocation and at the right level of register. The opening I am sorry to trouble you is the right choice for a semi-formal relationship; in several places the choice is made with fine effort.
why_this_band.grammatical_range_accuracy: The present perfect continuous, a semicolon-linked structure and time clauses are controlled; punctuation is accurate. Errors are rare and never stop the reader, but the flow is not quite as light as band 9 when three long sentences come one after another.

answers.what_would_lift_it: Cut one detail from the third paragraph and bring the effect into a single strong sentence, and combine the final two sentences; the letter would deliver the same information in fewer moves.
